data.raw_text:
The Philippines loses billions of dollars every year to floods and landslides, yet decisions about forests are still evaluated through the lens of short term economic returns.

More than 200,000 trees are slated for removal in Palawan for mining.

This is profoundly irresponsible.

Beyond the loss of trees, it increases the risk of watershed degradation, soil erosion, and flooding in one of the world's most climate-vulnerable nations.

Mining should not come at the expense of long-term environmental stability.

“BRAINS & BRAVERY ABOVE ALL

Filipinos are among the bravest soldiers in the world. Back in 2017, the world saw how Filipino soldiers fought terrorists in Marawi siege that makes even the US Navy Seals look amateurs. 

Then President Rodrigo Duterte led a six months war in Marawi giving the terrorist zero chance of victory. The international community pleaded cease fire but Duterte said No! Most terrorist died in that war.

Many soldier died in that crisis. They fought bravely. They die with honor. For what is there in life if there is nothing worth dying for.

Today, the Filipinos are under terrorist attack one again. A drug addict named Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. is not just terrorizing the Filipinos. He is stealing government money by hundreds of billions and undermines the whole Philppinee democracy systematically.

After stealing truck loads of money and bribing greedy ones, the Oligarchs, the Mainstream media, the corrupt politicians, the Catholic church, the Communists and CIA are now defenders of Marcos Jr. tyranny.

The Marcos Jr. kind is terrorism is deep, profound and systematic. He bribed and bought leaders to join him in plundering the nation. He deployed all the dirty tactics in CIA books to destroy the country from within. From blackmail, filing nuisance cases, giving suit cases full of cash and outright grave threats are initiated. 

Marcos Jr. being a drug addict sold his country and the Filipino people to the Americans. He is following the foot steps of Zelensky who allowed Ukraine to become the US War proxy versus Russia. Marcos Jr. is leading Philippines to become US Proxy in its war against China. Most Filipinos have no clue about this.

If our active Generals in the AFP continue to play deep, mute and blind. The United States Forces may use Philippines as launching pad to attack China and make our lands as catcher of Chinese retaliatory missiles. When that happens, the bravery of our soldiers will be of no use. 

These are not wild theories. Ukraine as we speak is a destroyed nation by Russian attacks. The Middle East is now on fire as missiles of Iran targets every place where US Military bases are situated. 

Every Filipino, soldier or not, must see the big picture and act accordingly before its too late. Or we will be destroyed eventually because we refused to use our brains and bravery when it still matters.

//Jun Abines
